jobs.description: About usAirbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.Job descriptionIn order to support the On-Board Data Handling and Communications Germany team, Airbus Defence and Space is offering anInternship in Satellite Radio Frequency Communications: Tool Development/Improvement (d/f/m)Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Development Engineer for Radio Frequency Communications (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the On-Board Data Handling and Communications Germany team as an intern (d/f/m)!- Location: Immenstaad/Friedrichshafen- Start: 01.04.2027- Duration: 3-6 monthsYour locationAt the Airbus site in Immenstaad on Lake Constance, you’ll work where the future of Connected Intelligence, Space, and Air Power takes shape. In an environment that offers vision, you will shape technological innovations across domains.Our location thrives on dialogue: on campus, you’ll connect with a unique network of experts in satellite technology, military aviation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, as well as tomorrow's Combat Cloud and Ground Support. Our collaboration is equally dynamic—in agile teams, we tackle the most complex challenges, from AI-powered Earth observation to secure cloud architectures. Anyone seeking technological excellence and interdisciplinary collaboration will find the ideal environment here.Your benefits- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.- Traveling within Europe is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.- Work with modern/diversified technologies.- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.Your tasks and responsibilitiesBased on the candidate’s profile and preferences one of the two work packages listed below can be considered:- Test Environment ImprovementIn the frame of the satellite integration and final verification of the spacecraft, it is necessary to process data generated during the satellite system test runs. This process is currently semi-automated. The objective is to increase automation of the test data processing and evaluation by writing respective tools and/or test scripts.The used test data for developing the tool will be the data generated by the real satellite Flight Model. The candidate will be in direct contact with the Engineering team, AIT team and next to the real satellite flight models in the clean room.The tool will improve the efficiency of the engineering and AIT team and have a direct impact on our day to day business- Link Budget ToolAirbus has developed a tool to analyse satellite Telecommand, Telemetry and Missions Data Link Budgets; i.e. Radio Frequency Signal Waveform Definition, Transmitter & Receiver characteristics, Link Margins, Data Rate, Atmospheric Model, Orbit Position etc.The selected candidate will make updates on this tool, document it and run test runs.For both work packages the selected candidate will first get introduced into the respective tool environment and will be provided with documentation to familiarize with the topic (self-study). In a second step the tool shall be used in a sandbox mode. The planned updates/development will be specified with a leading engineer and then implemented and tested. Finally all updates shall be well documented.Desired skills and qualifications- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Electrical Engineering, Information Theory or an equivalent field of study.- Proficiency in Matlab.- Language skills: English fluent, German/French/Spanish are beneficial.- Teamplayer in a multidisciplinary team.- Good Communication skills.- Focus on Radio Frequency is a plus.- Knowledge of link budgets is a plus.- Knowledge of automation for document generation (MS Word) is a plus.- AI Knowledge and Vibe Coding skills are a plus.Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.Not a 100% match? At HelloFresh, our mission is simple: to change the way people eat, forever. As a global digital-native FMCG company and the world's leading mealkit provider, we are transforming the traditional food supply chain through a data-driven, on-demand model that enables scalable and more sustainable food delivery. The HelloFresh Group includes eight brands serving customers across multiple meal occasions, including HelloFresh, Green Chef, EveryPlate, and Chefs Plate, as well as ready-to-eat meals from Factor and YouFoodz, meat and seafood subscriptions through Good Chop, and pet nutrition with The Pets Table. Through technology, data, and culinary innovation, we deliver personalized food experiences to millions of households worldwide. The Role : What’s in the BoxWe are looking for a talented Category Manager to become part of our European Strategic Sourcing Team. Your role will involve contributing to the development and implementation of category strategies spanning multiple markets across Europe. As an International Category Manager, you will collaborate closely with both local and global stakeholders and help ensure we source high-quality ingredients and packaging at the best costs.This position can be based in Paris or Berlin and we have openings across several categories, including Protein; Produce, Herbs and Fruits; Grocery & Dairy; and Packaging. You will be able to tell us which categories interest you most in your application, and we will match you to the best fit.Above all, we are looking for people who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don't "tick all the boxes" but think you'd thrive in this role, we would like to learn more about you.What You'll Do : The Recipe- Shape the category strategy: Help build and roll out category strategies across European markets, aligned with our business objectives and supply chain needs, working hand in hand with senior team members.- Own supplier relationships and negotiations: Manage key supplier relationships across markets and lead negotiations within your scope to secure the best possible terms, working independently and constructively with internal and external stakeholders.- Drive savings: Identify and deliver cost reduction opportunities by leveraging volumes and improving processes across markets.- Build the numbers behind every decision: Develop robust cost models, run make-or-buy analyses and monitor key commodity prices, so we pay fair prices and make well-informed sourcing decisions.- Stay ahead of the market: Forecast future cost pricing using data, industry knowledge and Generative AI tools, track market trends, regulatory changes and emerging technologies, and challenge the status quo with ideas to improve our processes.- Lead projects and grow others: Drive short-term procurement projects, support long-term initiatives with cross-functional teams, solve non-routine topics autonomously (aligning regularly with your manager on priorities), and mentor junior team members, interns and working students.What You'll Bring : - Bachelor's or master's degree from a top-tier college or university, preferably in business, engineering, supply chain, finance, or science.- Minimum of 3 years of strategic procurement or production experience, preferably in the food or food-packaging industry, or alternatively as a management consultant with a focus on operations.- Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and drive implementation.- Strong communication skills and the ability to work successfully in flexible team structures around the world.- Strong organizational and project management skills with a track record of successfully implementing cross-functional projects.- Capability to excel in flexible global team structures amid a reasonable degree of uncertainty.- Comfortable contributing to and managing projects, including developing new processes, SLAs, and KPIs.- Strong at devising creative solutions to supply issues, as well as designing, communicating, and executing action plans for effective resolution.- Convincing track record of successful negotiations with external partners.- Strong quantitative and analytical skills.- Excellent English proficiency is required, another European language is a plus.- Willingness to travel internationally up to 25% of the time.What we offer: The Toppings- The chance to have a serious impact role on one of the most exciting foodtech companies in Europe- A vibrant & international environment with a great culture & DNA- A guaranteed steep learning curve and boost for your career- A passionate, proactive, driven and dynamic French team- Offices located in the center of Paris (Paris 1er)- Competitive compensation- Delicious reductions on our HelloFresh boxes- Top tier employee experience and employees perks (Alan Blue insurance, Swile (tickets restaurant), GymLib, reductions on transport)Ergänzende Informationen:Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach VereinbarungAnforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Produktion, FertigungExpertenkenntnisse: Lieferantenmanagement

We, the Max Planck Institute for Medical Research, are one of 85 institutes and research centers of the Max Planck Society (MPG) for the advancement of science. Our focus is on basic medical research. We currently employ around 270 people in science and administration, mainly at our location in Heidelberg. Another location for our institute is currently being established in Heilbronn. We are also part of the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim, an association of the region's leading life science research institutions.The MPG strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. As the MPG has set itself the goal of employing more people with severe disabilities, applications from people with severe disabilities are expressly welcome. In addition, the MPG wants to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore expressly encouraged to apply.The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.Tasks- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples- Histological characterization of biological samples- Quantitative image and data analysis- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental resultsProfile- You hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in reproductive biology, developmental biology, biology, biophysics, physics, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.- We are looking for a candidate with strong experimental aptitude, excellent practical laboratory skills, manual dexterity, and a quantitative and analytical mindset.- You should enjoy technically demanding experimental work, be able to interpret complex data critically and rigorously, and be motivated to work across disciplinary boundaries.- Willingness to work with laboratory mice and to complete the required laboratory-animal training is essential.- Previous experience in reproductive biology, experimental biophysics, microscopy, or work with laboratory animals is advantageous but not required. Candidates with a background in reproductive biology and an interest in quantitative and biophysical approaches are particularly encouraged to apply.- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.Our offerThe position is funded for an initial period of three years within the ERC Starting Grant REPROMECH, with the possibility of extension, and is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible.We offer a vibrant international research environment, access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for quantitative microscopy and mechanobiology, and opportunities for scientific training and conference participation.Remuneration: 75% of pay group E13 under TVöD Bund.We look forward to receiving your application, including a cover letter, curriculum vitae, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts, and contact details of two academic referees. Applications must be submitted electronically via the application portal (https://bewerbermanagement.net/en/jobposting/5572b068e91236d723de14e45b3737686f35fab70/apply) by 1 November 2026.For further information, please contact Dr. Stephanie Möllmert (stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:stephanie.moellmert@mr.mpg.de) ).For general questions, please contact Ms. Julia Gauglitz (julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de (https://mailto:julia.gauglitz@mr.mpg.de) ) from human resources.
